purpose: Iterative small full-B/C mechanism qualification with official dynamic frames and no hard four-request limit

selection.rule: The first six original public-trace chains in their existing order; no performance, latency, SLO outcome or post-run support filtering
selection.scope_warning: This is a support-window mechanism smoke, not evidence of full-public-trace coverage or superiority

generation_and_deadline.whole_chain_rule: Primary strict chain rule: arrival + 20 * actual chain stage_num; finish <= deadline
generation_and_deadline.scheduler_request_slo_rule: Both arms receive the official client request SLO scaled by collection_id % 4 + 1; C chain-goal deadline uses this received value times actual stage_num
generation_and_deadline.official_native_goodput_rule: Reproduce the official request goodput using the official scaled collection-SLO convention; report it separately from primary unscaled strict-chain attainment and strict-chain call goodput

arms.B: Full official JITServe policy, 50-tick frames, QRF/graph matching and dynamic sliding-window in the shared backend
arms.C: stage7 v3_chain_dynamic_v1 with chain-level actions, official prediction/graph input and the identical dynamic backend
arms.successful_pair_limit: iterate only after trace analysis, a new version and CPU qualification; stop after the frozen win criterion

frozen_mechanism.decision_risk_source: median graph-max normalized residual over the frozen 99 CAL graphs; not a JCT coverage claim
frozen_mechanism.rescue_lease: lease yielding is disabled; attainable anchors renew without replanning
frozen_mechanism.rescue_selection: EDF for initial admission and least-laxity for incumbent continuation; renewal and candidate selection use the same forecasts() with cache recovery included; all candidates are CAL-risk-attainable and include chains above the virtual-time fairness floor; hopeless KV can be reclaimed, and any attainable chain can be swapped only when its own slack covers its risk work, lease and round-trip recovery, independent of deadline order
frozen_mechanism.non_anchor_priority: Official native priority for every attainable non-anchor on frames and non-frame ticks; hopeless chains last. Model first-step witness order applies only to the first dispatch, and live priorities govern subsequent frames and running-queue eviction.
frozen_mechanism.collective_allocation: restore the official sum of peer remaining decode times
frozen_mechanism.host_full_preemption: defer custom control and return an empty scheduler output without recompute or swap whenever resident blocks exceed either vLLM free host blocks or real backend ledger free host tokens
frozen_mechanism.cleanup_audit: preserve server audit on cleanup failures and reject unexpected server exit codes in the controller
frozen_mechanism.first_step_order: Shared deadline_admission.admission_pauses() drives both policy and first-step projection; live native order applies among unpaused non-anchor chains
frozen_mechanism.background_admission: Pause risk-infeasible READY chains while attainable work exists. Also pause a later-deadline READY chain only if its predicted latest start is beyond the earliest attainable deadline plus one nominal frame and round-trip KV recovery. Reconsider at official frames; release incumbent only after its bounded lease completes; drain all calls.

qualification_gates: B and C complete all six main chains and preserve all 40 main calls plus the separate warmup
Both arms use the same public prompts, deadlines, generation contract and backend source
Both arms execute real batches above four requests with official dynamic sliding-window semantics
C has supported multi-goal candidates and complete model/forced execution witnesses without forced spinning
No compound group is split and KV/token/slot accounting remains consistent
Strict whole-chain attainment, official scaled SLO, native goodput, same-ID chains, JCT, tail latency and overhead are independently recomputed
All study-owned processes exit and GPU0 is released
stop_rules: Stop without an authorized idle physical GPU0; do not select another device
If B fails, do not start C; preserve every failed and partial attempt
If C does not win, analyze trace and change only one coherent mechanism version before CPU requalification and the same small pair
No chain substitution, deadline tuning, added seeds, resource enlargement, formal matrix or HOLDOUT
Preserve every failed and partial attempt and signal only registered processes
